description.fun: Kartana is a paper-thin Ultra Beast from the Ultra Forest, folded like origami, and every edge of its body is as sharp as a well-honed blade. Anyone who attacks it gets cut down in a single strike, and it dances lightly out of the way of blows. It's tied for the lightest Pokémon of all, and being so thin, it's weak against fire and moisture.
description.guide: Kartana is a Grass- and Steel-type Ultra Beast, codenamed UB-04 Blade, with a thin, paper-like body that cuts like a sword. It has the highest base Attack of any Grass- or Steel-type Pokémon. It is a counterpart to Celesteela: one is tied for the heaviest Pokémon, the other for the lightest.
description.tagline: A paper-thin origami samurai whose every edge is a blade
